Vise od 2 decenije sam pacijent Dr Pera,covek koji mi je pokazao da stomatologija nije bauk,da odlazak kod stomatologa moze proci i uz osmeh.Odgvornost ,postovanje pacijenta ,gde novac nije primarna stvar
retko danas u medicini mozete videti.Zelim da traju i dalje ,jer zaista su bez svake konkurencije.
Great clinic! I’m very satisfied with doctors and staff also everything is new, very well equipped and clean! All recommendations!👍👍👍
Na svetskom nivou, klinika,oprema i izuzetan kolektiv !!!👌🫶💯✨💫

The doctors are true masters, they were so attentive and careful, they explained everything they were doing and always told me if I was not gonna feel anything or it’s gonna be unpleasant before every procedure and kept making sure I felt good. And it’s all in English which I appreciate a lot. For me being a naturally very anxious person this experience was top-notch comfortable.
The clinic itself is brand new and sparkling clean, the equipment is very modern.

The only thing is that it was a bit disorganised, I had to come three times to get braces removed the first one the doctor didn’t show up, the second time they had a look and booked me for the third appointment incl braces removal, an xray and a cleaning, and during the third time another doctor wanted to reschedule since they didn’t have some of the tools and didn’t expect to remove braces, finally found the way and removed the braces but didn’t do the xray, the cleaning with another doctor that day wasn’t done properly as I discovered only later when I got home.
Najbolji doktori, ljubazne sestre i administrativne radnice, sve preporuke 🙂
Najbolji doktori i ljubazno osoblje. Sve preporuke! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Najbolji tim,  od medicinske sestre do doktora,uvjek ispostovani za sve ,dr Miljan a i dr Medina (divna ,strpljiva brza sa toliko paznje i ljubavi prilazi djeci....).
Odlicno iskustvo. Savremena tehnika, doktori dobri, ljubazni i komunikativni. Nisu alavi na pare! Sve u svemu svaka preporuka!!!
Dosli smo iz Splita, odusevljeni smo uslugom i krajnjim rezultatom. Preporuka za cijeli tim! Svaka cast
Best dentistry I’v been going to for the decades.

Najbolji!
Svaka preporuka za Micunovic Medical tim! :)

Jednostavno dr Miljan Micunovic je dragulj stomatologije sto se tice najzahtjevnijih zahvata, a sto je najvaznije potpuno bezbolno. Mislim da je Crna Gora pocastvovana sto ordiniraju u Podgorici. Iz  licnog iskustva ne postoji te preporuke na bilo kojeg stomatologa koji bi mi mogao i prici po znanju, struci, pristupu, profesionalnosti dr. Miljanu Micunovicu. Miki Dragicevic zahvalan dr. Miljanu Micunovicu i timu doktora i da ne zaboravim sve rijeci hvale za anesteziologa. Jednostavno mislio sam da nikad necu pobijediti strah od zubara ali posle njihove intervencije strah je nestao.
Samo riječi hvale, za sve zaposlene...

Un excellent accompagnement   au niveau de conseils, de diagnostic  et de suivi. Malgré la complexité de ma situation dentaire, Dr Miljan Micunivic a réussi à répondre à mes exigences  contrairement à ses autres collègues dentistes. Doté d‘une nature calme et patiente, Dr Micunovic a su être à  mon écoute en respectant mes besoins et mes demandes.  De meme , un grand Merci également  à son équipe pour leur  professionnalisme et leur  humanisme. Je  recommande  vivement le cabinet de dr Miljan Micunovic!,,
